name: Dog House | Gratiot Gold
description:
Lemon Tree x Animal Mints Bx | Sativa | Citrussy Terpenes: Myrcene, Limonene, Linalool

Dense, dark green buds icy with trichomes and threaded with wild orange hairs. Distinctive profile of earth and diesel spiked with tart citrus and a minty exhale. A DogHouse Crew favorite.
